simple.summary: בַּעַל הָמוֹן (Baʻal Hâmôwn) means Baal-Hamon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Song 8 11.

definitions.full: H1174. Baal Hamon הָמוֺן בַּ֫עַל proper name, of a location ( possessor of abundance ; or is ׳ב here proper name, of divinity?) Song 8:11 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1167 and 1995 ; possessor of a multitude;
